selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a natural dependency chain. The player must first find gray wool (which establishes awareness of where sheep/wool resources are in the scene), and then shear a sheep to obtain wool directly. The logical dependency is that finding gray wool requires locating a sheep (or wool block), and shearing a sheep requires having shears and being near a sheep. We can design the scene so that the player must first locate gray wool (placed as a block or dropped item to orient them), and then find and shear a nearby sheep. This creates a coherent multi-hop task: the gray wool serves as a landmark/clue leading to the sheep that needs to be sheared. The tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft expertise beyond basic navigation and item use.

edges.reason: Finding gray wool orients the player toward the sheep area; the sheep to shear is located near the gray wool landmark

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the gray wool structure (centered at spawn-relative 11,2,9) and face it from within 5 blocks. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walks to the structure (~12 blocks from spawn) rather than just spotting it from the starting position. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because shearing a gray sheep (Color:7) drops gray_wool into the player's inventory. The player starts with shears but no wool in inventory, so having at least 1 gray_wool confirms a sheep was successfully sheared. This is preferred over mob-state checks because shearing doesn't kill the sheep — it only removes wool, making inventory_has the most direct and reliable verification.

Two gray sheep (Color:7, NoAI) are positioned just beyond the structure at ~10,1,13 and ~12,1,14. A cobblestone wall path runs from ~5,1,4 to ~5,1,8 guiding the player. Torches at ~7,1,6 and ~0,1,3 provide visual markers. Player starts with shears in hotbar.
task_text: Find the gray wool structure in the field, then locate and shear one of the nearby sheep.
design_notes: The gray wool structure serves as a visible landmark ~12 blocks from spawn. The sheep are positioned 3-4 blocks behind the structure (higher z), creating a natural find-then-approach flow. The cobblestone wall and torches guide the player's eye toward the wool. NoAI sheep won't wander away. The cleared zone (23x23 blocks) ensures visibility. Player spawns facing the general direction of the structure.
